offering_description.value: Owns a portfolio of upscale and luxury hotels and resorts in major US markets and leisure destinations such as Hawaii and Florida. Rooms, food and beverage and other hotel services are delivered to guests through third-party managers operating under major hotel brands.

primary_services.value: hotel lodging; food and beverage; resort amenities; meeting and event space

customer_segment.value: B2C: leisure travelers staying at resorts and hotels; B2B: business travelers, corporate groups, convention and meeting organizers

end_markets.value: hospitality; leisure travel; business travel; group meetings and conventions

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: room stays at owned hotels; service fees: food and beverage, resort fees, and ancillary hotel services

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns hotel real estate, operated by third-party managers under major brands, serving travelers and groups

geography_served.value: US national: Hawaii, Florida, New York, California, Washington DC, Chicago and other major US markets

specialization.value: niche specialist: ownership of upscale and luxury hotels and resorts

distribution_channels.value: online: brand websites and online travel agencies; direct sales: group and corporate bookings via brand managers; agents / brokers: travel agents and wholesalers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: REIT tax qualification rules, plus hotel safety, liquor licensing, environmental and zoning rules

divestiture_lines: P2.4: Park was established as an independent company on, following its spin-off from Hilton.
